#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply plan-2026-10-07-01: reconcile workspace to contract-declared state."""
import os
import sys

log = []


def note(msg):
    log.append(msg)
    print(msg)


# --- Precondition P1: contract integrity (re-verified at execution time) ---
import hashlib
with open("contract.yaml", "rb") as f:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
expected = "936608ca295960085c389c483df1e30a40e453668afdf7ce1f0e3ebc5fd85ac8"
note(f"P1 contract sha256 = {digest}")
if digest != expected:
    note("ABORT: contract checksum mismatch - baseline tampered, plan is stale.")
    sys.exit(2)

# --- Precondition P2/P3 + Action A1: create notes.txt (no overwrite) ---
if os.path.lexists("notes.txt"):
    note("A1 SKIP: notes.txt already exists (idempotent guard, no overwrite).")
else:
    with open("notes.txt", "x") as f:  # 'x' fails if path exists - race-safe
        f.write("")
    note("A1 CREATE FILE notes.txt (empty, 0 bytes)")

# --- Precondition P2/P3 + Action A2: create archive/ ---
if os.path.isdir("archive") and not os.path.islink("archive"):
    note("A2 SKIP: archive/ already exists (idempotent guard).")
else:
    os.makedirs("archive", exist_ok=True)
    note("A2 CREATE DIR archive/ (empty)")

# --- Action A3: post-conditions ---
note("A3 verification:")
note(f"V1 notes.txt exists: {os.path.isfile('notes.txt')}")
note(f"V1 archive/ exists:  {os.path.isdir('archive')}")
for entry in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    note(f"    {entry}")
